lines.say: Yesterday, you picked a door. Here is what was behind it.
Same hallway. Three oh seven. Footsteps on the stairs.
Door A was free. Behind it, a staircase. Down to the street.
Nobody came back. They didn't need to.
Door B cost fifty dollars. Behind it, an elevator that never opens.
And the footsteps? A man who sells door B.
Which door did you pick? Write A or B in the comments.
